sv.title: Migranter överväldigar lilla kanarieön
sv.summary: En glesbefolkad liten kanarieö har tagit emot tusentals migrerande människor på kort tid. Bara under tisdagen kom nästan 2 000 med båt till den spanska ögruppen.

en.title: Migrants overwhelm small Canary Island
en.summary: A sparsely populated small Canary island has received thousands of migrants in a short time. On Tuesday alone, nearly 2,000 arrived by boat to the Spanish archipelago.
